prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1187; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision in which our client was struck by another vehicle while turning left. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is now receiving medical care.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or any other means. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle data, repair records, and any dash camera or telematics information in your possession or your insured's possession. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
